name: [💎 CRYSTAL] Jump To Steal An Egg
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Jump To Steal An Egg! 🥚

💡 How to Play:

🦘 Jump high and steal Eggs!
🏃 Escape from the Pets before they catch you!
🏠 Bring the Eggs back to your Pen!
🐣 Hatch Eggs to unlock new Pets!
💵 Earn Cash and upgrade your Jump!

⏰ Your Pets make money OFFLINE!

👍 Like the game and join the group for more updates!
